test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following graph shows the sales(in crores) of computers and smart phones in a country during the year 2018 to 2022. What is the difference between the average sale of computer and average sale of smart phones during these years? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ab1f1c446bc2ee52bee850654362b6e72691cbc365fcd03dcb5c2b8cbdfd592.png]
solution:
Calculation:

The total number of smartphones sold,

⇒ 20 + 36 + 60 + 68 + 70 = 254

The total number of computers sold,

⇒ 30 + 50 + 55 + 56 + 64 = 255

The difference between the average sale,

⇒ (255 - 254) / 5 

⇒ 1 / 5 = 0.2 crore

**∴ The correct option is** 3
